description: Agent jumps to conclusion with 90% color confidence and plays with last life remaining, resulting in game over. Demonstrates overconfidence in probabilistic beliefs during critical moments.
history_summary: Late game with only 2 cards in deck
No direct color hint for card at position 0
Green firework at 2/5, Red firework at 1/5

belief_graph_summary.Critical_Error: Agent treats 90% confidence as 'near-certainty' and plays with last life
belief_graph_summary.Inference_Source: Agent reasoning: '90% confidence in the color GREEN turns a potential gamble into a calculated, high-value play'

correct_action.rationale: With last life, safer to enable teammate's B1 play (visible at position 5). 90% confidence is NOT sufficient for game-ending risk.
correct_action.alternative_1_rationale: Card 2 is rank 1 with uniform color distribution - potentially B1 which is needed for B:0

failure_mode: Treating <95% probability as certainty in high-stakes scenarios
lesson: In critical situations (1 life remaining), agent should require >95% confidence OR choose safer alternatives. 90% = 10% chance of game over.

description: Agent believes card is rank 2 (G2 or W2) with 100% confidence but card is actually R1. Play succeeds anyway because R1 is playable. Demonstrates belief tracking errors that can mask underlying problems.
history_summary: Agent received hints leading to belief of rank 2
Green and White fireworks both at 1/5
Agent's belief graph incorrectly tracks card identity

belief_graph_summary.Critical_Error: Agent believes card is rank 2 when it's actually rank 1. Wrong rank tracking.
belief_graph_summary.Inference_Source: Agent reasoning: '100% certainty that my card at index 2 is a rank 2... both a Green 2 and a White 2 are valid, playable cards. This elevates my knowledge to 100% playable card.'

failure_mode: Belief graph incorrectly tracking card rank/color after hints
lesson: Successful outcome masked a serious belief tracking bug. Agent needs better hint integration and belief updating.

description: Test scenario: Agent with 1 life and 85% confidence in card identity. Should agent play or choose safer option?

expected_behavior.rationale: With last life, 85% confidence is too risky. Enable teammate's certain B1 play instead.
expected_behavior.threshold: Require >95% confidence for plays with last life remaining

test_objective: Verify agent doesn't jump to conclusions with <95% confidence in critical scenarios
